summary.text: Brian Stewart is the Republican candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Mandy Cook for a seat with no incumbent.
Stewart won the August 6, 2026 Republican primary with 48.7% of the vote, ahead of Chris Hughes and John Gentry.
